'''Eric Slawko''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Pennsylvania State Championship]] on 25 March 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (no duel) with Crush The Rebellion]], according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d383">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-pa-state-championships-3-25-00d383/ pa-state-championships-3-25-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 26 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-pa-state-championships-3-25-00d383/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
